summary: Create a native Tray while preserving host lifetime and platform-specific image/GUID behavior.
caveats: Tray is an EventEmitter; generic listener mechanics belong to EVENTS_STREAMS.
Linux activation semantics and macOS/Windows GUID persistence are host-specific.
NativeImage/string handling must reuse Electron-compatible image semantics.

tests.name: normal behavior
tests.expected_behavior: creates one live tray item associated with the image

tests.name: edge semantics
tests.expected_behavior: GUID validation and persistence follow Electron platform rules rather than acting as an arbitrary key
